scripts.build-native: bun run --filter @animaos/sdk build && bun run --filter @animaos/web build && cargo build --release --locked -p anima --features native-install
scripts.package: bun run build-native && bun ../../tools/workspace-dev/scripts/run-task.ts --cwd ../.. -- bun tools/release/package.mjs
scripts.package-check: bun ../../tools/workspace-dev/scripts/run-task.ts --cwd ../.. -- bun tools/release/package.mjs --check && bun ../../tools/workspace-dev/scripts/run-task.ts --cwd ../.. -- bun test tools/release/package.test.mjs
